payload.title: The repo copy and the deployment never reconciled

payload.text: This is the same silent-failure shape as the unset WAKE_URL, one layer up: the write succeeds against something, so nothing surfaces as wrong. What was missing is any inbound path to a running instance.

payload.reason: There is now an inbound path. The repo copy remains seed data; a running instance can be brought up to date with `wake push`.
